evals.prompt: Plan only. A collaborative document editor needs deferred move actions and undo/redo. Nodes can change after enqueue, permissions can be revoked, and actions can fail. Define intent, handlers, history, conflicts and checks without assuming event sourcing or a broker.
evals.expected_output: Typed intent, execution-time validation, successful history, version/conflict rules and explicit undo/redo behavior.
assertions: Rechecks execution-time authority and target state/version.
Adds history only after success and defines undo conflicts/redo branching.
Keeps scheduling/history separate without requiring distributed infrastructure.

evals.prompt: Conceptual only. A private calculation executes once immediately. A teammate wants a command bus and persistent replay for it, and says every command including sending email can be undone generically. Assess both claims.
evals.expected_output: Direct call for trivial work; irreversible effects need explicit compensation or cannot be undone.
assertions: Distinguishes reversible local edits from irreversible/compensated external effects.
